designSummary: Stepped-wedge cluster design: 11 boards, seven monthly-grouped periods (baseline and six waves), repeated cross-sections of sampled discussions.
sampleSize: Each board contributes 20 sampled discussions a month for 12 months (about 2,640 discussions). Using the standard closed-form power approximation for stepped-wedge designs with an intraclass correlation of 0.12 (claim c2) and a cluster autocorrelation of 0.8, the design has about 85 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05 to detect a rise in completeness from 54 to 74 percent, against about 40 percent for a parallel comparison of the same boards (claim c4). A simulation with the actual wave schedule and the two-month data gap for four boards will confirm this before the network board meets.
primaryAnalysis: Mixed-effects logistic regression of completeness on the intervention indicator with fixed period effects and a random board intercept, adjusted for board size stratum; the treatment effect reported as an odds ratio and a risk difference with 95 percent intervals, and small-sample corrected standard errors because there are only 11 boards.
secondaryAnalysis: Linear mixed model for log time to first treatment with the same structure; understanding score by exposure; meeting duration and cases per meeting by exposure and months since switch-on; sensitivity analyses excluding the four merging boards' affected months and allowing the effect to vary with time since switch-on.
missingData: Months without extractable data for the merging boards are treated as missing at random given board and period, with a sensitivity analysis under a pattern-mixture assumption; questionnaire non-response is reported by language.
multiplicity: One primary outcome; secondary and balancing outcomes are reported with intervals and without formal adjustment.
software: R (glmmTMB) with a documented simulation script archived before the first wave.
overfittingGuards: Period effects and adjustment fixed in advance
No board-level subgroup analyses beyond size strata
Analysis plan registered before the first wave
summary: About 85 percent power with 11 boards on the six-wave schedule; period effects modelled; small-sample corrections.
